limit_description: Terra glows with unstable crystal light. For 1 round, her next offensive spell deals an extra 2d6 damage of the spell’s type, and she gains resistance to that same damage type until the start of her next turn.
backstory:
Background: Crystal-Touched Scholar

Traits: Brilliant, quiet, intense, socially awkward, fascinated by forgotten magic.
Goals: Discover why the crystals react to her presence, protect Locke from his own terrible ideas, and decode the ancient summon script.
Quirks: Accidentally says terrifying things in a calm voice. Takes notes during combat.
repeating_cantrips_-c1_cantrip_effect: Ranged spell attack to deal 1d10 fire damage.
repeating_cantrips_-c2_cantrip_effect: Create a spectral hand that can manipulate objects up to 30 ft away.
